I arrived at the restaurant around 3:00 PM on February 22nd. When I arrived, two staff members confirmed I was at the front desk, but for some reason they didn't come out right away (one of them seemed free). Finally, they came to the front desk, and when I told them I had a reservation, they said they didn't have one. I told them I'd called the other day to ask if there were any available spots on the weekend, and they said they had one available this Sunday from 3:30 PM. They then went back to the room behind the glass, talked with a staff member, and then returned to the front desk. They said, "Since you called the other day, today's reservations must have been booked, so we can't make a reservation for you. Maybe you made a mistake." I don't know if the reservations were booked the other day, but I was able to make a reservation for February 22nd from 15:30 PM. Then, they went back to the room behind the glass again, this time loud enough for me at the front desk to hear, and said, "What should I do? If we do this today, it'll take until 9:00 PM..." At this point, I felt very uncomfortable. They tried to see if they could do it that day, but they said they would work until about 9pm even though they close at 8pm. Given their past behavior, I felt uneasy about leaving my dog ​​with people like this for such a long period of time, so I declined. I have used many salons, but this was the first time I had such an unpleasant experience. I will never use their services again. Thank you very much.

I have been shampooing here for over a year. In the winter, my dog ​​tends to get an upset stomach after a bath, but after shampooing and bathing at this salon, he has never had an upset stomach.
They have a very polite and skilled groomer. Their service is also kind, and I'm always very grateful.
